heading: Continuing offense
lead: Failure to file a registration statement as required by this subchapter is a continuing offense for as long as such failure exists, notwithstanding any statute of limitation or other statute to the contrary.

notes.text: Codification Section was not enacted as part of the Internal Security Act of 1950 which comprises subchapters I to III of this chapter.
